art_direction: 俯视淡粉方院中一弯蓝色水池，墙角投影与圆形天窗形成安静几何。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Use an overhead view of a small square courtyard with pale rose walls and one curved blue pool. The pool is shaped like a broad comma and occupies the central lower half, while a circular opening in the roof casts a bright disc on the opposite wall. Simplify the courtyard into a handful of clean planes with deep plum shadows. Keep the exterior background a nearly white warm gray, separating the miniature structure from the page. No furniture, people, or plants. Let the water remain one calm color with a single thin reflection. The composition should work as an abstract arrangement first and a believable miniature space on closer inspection.
